note: Half-life validation vs replay ground truth, frozen before any cycle-2 screen outcome was read. Length approximated birth+pearls; identity-by-head-cell is the conservative reset model.

chosen.rule: knee-based: long = the knee of the ghost/lag saturation curves (both saturate by h=4 while est_err keeps growing; matches the existing swarm/density constant, now data-validated); short = fastest h with >=0.2 rounds exit memory and zero contact lag.
chosen.revision_note: The pre-stated rule (min contact_lag s.t. est_err<=1.0) was degenerate: a near-raw window always wins on lag. Revised to the knee rule AFTER reading this table but BEFORE any cycle-2 screen outcome was read; the raw numbers above are untouched.

findings.pos_err_note: the send-side position EWMA (h=4, as swarm.LOCAL) lags the true head by ~3.2 tiles on average: the price of fuzzed position reporting, and the effective spatial resolution of remote evidence.
